milestone: 1.87 elemental dungeon architecture — staged, not published
implementation: Original one-mesh recessed wall architecture: clipped forge arches and broad piers in Molten Core; slender pointed arcades in Tempest Spire; rounded blind arches and tide courses in Abyssal Well; asymmetric fractured trim in Umbral Nexus.

Stepped sloped plinths/crowns and inset backing catch actual light inside the existing solid. Recesses are not doors, new walking space, or ground solids. Small wall/corner segments retain boxes; no added interactive object.

Opaque geometry is cached per instance/dimension. Foreground cutaways retain one simple box; the legacy corridor constructor now chooses its own opaque/cutaway geometry instead of sharing layered geometry across both.

All original bays/supports retained on Low; only Water's rounded arch tessellation is reduced10 to6 segments. No new material, texture, light, dependency, per-frame generation, actor/equipment or server rule.

candidatePatchNotes: Fire, Air, Water and Umbral dungeons now have distinct recessed stone arches, supports and layered wall courses inside their existing collision boundaries.
Foreground walls stay simple and translucent so the architecture does not obscure your character. Wall crowns no longer have overlapping surface faces.
